description: Instrumental Variables and the Projection Formula; published open data from Angrist and Lavy's (1999) replication deposit.
observation_unit: One fifth-grade class in an Israeli Jewish public school, tested in June 1991; scores are class averages. Classes are nested in schools (schlcode).
source: Published open data: Angrist and Lavy, replication data for Using Maimonides' Rule to Estimate the Effect of Class Size on Student Achievement, Harvard Dataverse; CC0 1.0.

citation.dataset: Angrist, J. D., & Lavy, V. (2009). Replication data for: Using Maimonides' Rule to Estimate the Effect of Class Size on Student Achievement (Version 1.0) [Dataset]. Harvard Dataverse. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/XRSUJU
citation.article: Angrist, J. D., & Lavy, V. (1999). Using Maimonides' rule to estimate the effect of class size on scholastic achievement. Quarterly Journal of Economics, 114(2), 533-575. https://doi.org/10.1162/003355399556061

retrieved.version: Dataverse version 1.0, released 2009-01-21; final5 in its original Stata format, whose MD5 equals the Dataverse record.

filters: final5.dta is prepared as in the depositors' AngristLavy_Table4.do, in its order: 100 is subtracted from avgverb and avgmath where they exceed 100, and a class's avgverb (avgmath) is set to missing when no pupil took the reading (math) test.

Kept: classes with 2 to 44 pupils (1 < classize < 45) in schools with more than five fifth graders (c_size > 5), with c_leom = 1 and c_pik < 3, and with a reading score. This leaves 2,019 classes in 1,002 schools.
func1 = c_size / (int((c_size - 1) / 40) + 1), Maimonides' predicted class size, defined as in the do-file.
Scores stored as single-precision numbers are written as the shortest decimals that reproduce them (74.11 rather than 74.1100006).
schlcode, classid, c_size, tipuach, classize, func1, avgverb and avgmath are kept in the depositors' row order; the other columns are left out.

columns.name: schlcode
columns.description: School code; classes in the same school share it

columns.name: c_size
columns.description: September fifth-grade enrolment in the school

columns.name: tipuach
columns.description: Percent disadvantaged: share of the school's pupils from disadvantaged backgrounds

columns.name: classize
columns.description: Class size: pupils in the class in the spring

columns.name: func1
columns.description: Maimonides' predicted class size from enrolment (the excluded instrument)
